title: Bringing Our Posts With Us: Internet Archive Europe Moves to Bonfire
content:
An archive should never lose its own history when it changes address.

Internet Archive Europe (IAE) is moving its fediverse home to Bonfire, an open source framework for federated social networks. You can now find us at @hq@community.internetarchive.eu. If you already follow us, you don’t need to do anything. Your follow moves with us.

The fediverse lets people talk to each other across thousands of independent servers that share the same open language. You can already leave one server for another and keep your name and your followers. On most fediverse software, though, your old posts stay behind on the server you left.

Bonfire’s migration tools change that. You can bring your post history with you, from another Bonfire server or from other fediverse software that exports an archive of your posts, and every post keeps its original date and link.

For an organisation whose mission is to preserve the web, this detail matters. We spend our days making sure the record survives when websites move, change or disappear. Our own record should survive our moves too.
